poses.caption: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Bend your hips and knees toward a parallel squat, keeping your chest up, feet flat and weights at your sides. Press through your feet to stand.

jobs.prompt: Use case scientific-educational. Original premium ADULT male detailed anatomical exercise illustration canonical1555 DUMBBELL SQUAT V2. TWO equal square cells side by side WIDE2:1 landscape same full body model camera scale FRONT-SIDE three-quarter view facing RIGHT. Hold ONE matched moderate dumbbell in EACH hand at SIDES palms inward neutral secure wrapped grips arms hang STRAIGHT vertically throughout. Both weights outside legs never between knees or resting on thighs/floor, weights identical size each pose. Feet shoulder-width toes slightly outward soles FLAT same position both poses. LEFT START standing TALL hips/knees extended soft ribs pelvis stacked neutral spine. RIGHT BOTTOM squat hips BACK and DOWN until BOTH thighs roughly PARALLEL floor, knees track over toes, chest up torso modest forward lean neutral long back neck aligned gaze ahead/down, heels stay flat. Dumbbells hang outside knees clear ground, elbows never curl.
